first.rationale: Onboarding completion is currently down, and memory_86 directly indicates that shorter onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Promotional pricing is the strongest alternative given competitive pressure, so memory_73 should also be verified; however, its summary does not establish retention, margin, or downstream customer quality. Pending verification, simplifying onboarding is the more sustainable intervention, though its long-term qualified-revenue impact remains uncertain.
